description: Add Playwright e2e coverage for Issue #17 and update the spec set and both READMEs so documentation stays truthful (spec-driven development is graded). The e2e tests assert the 'last updated' text and manual refresh affordance render for an in-progress 2026 bracket and are ABSENT for a results-only season; the manual refresh button is driven deterministically rather than waiting 60s. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: In frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts: the existing SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET already contains an in_progress World Series series and an updatedAt ISO string - reuse it. Add a helper to stub a results-only / no-in-progress case if needed (e.g. a 2026 bracket whose series are all 'final', or rely on the existing 2024/2025 seed path which is results-only), so the e2e can assert the auto-refresh affordance is present for in-progress and absent for results-only.

Add a new spec frontend/e2e/refresh.spec.ts (Playwright) that: stubs /bracket for 2026 with the in-progress fixture (stubBracket2026), loads '/', and asserts the localized 'last updated' text (default UI language is Japanese, so match /最終更新/) and a manual refresh control (match the localized '更新' button by role) are visible. Then click the refresh button and assert a second /bracket request is made (e.g. count route calls) and the view does not show the full loading status during the refresh (bracket region stays visible). Keep it deterministic - drive the manual button, do not wait for the 60s interval.

Add an assertion/spec that for a results-only season (navigate the season selector to 2024, which falls back to the bundled seed and has no in-progress series) the auto-refresh affordance is NOT present: assert the '更新' refresh button and '最終更新' text have count 0, confirming criterion 1 at the UI level.

If the first e2e run reports a missing browser, run `npx playwright install chromium -w @mlb/frontend` once, then re-run. Run with headless chromium (--no-sandbox is the project default per the briefing).

Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md and design.md to describe the new auto-refresh behavior: the polling predicate (predictable season AND in-progress series), the 60s interval and its relation to the ~15min cache TTL, Page Visibility pause/resume, the last-updated relative-time display, the manual refresh button, flicker-free refresh preserving scroll + selected series, and unobtrusive failure handling. Keep the specs describing the system AS BUILT and tracing to the real modules (relativeTime.ts, useAutoRefresh.ts, HomePage.tsx).

Update BOTH README.md and README.ja.md to document the auto-refresh / last-updated / manual-refresh feature truthfully (keeping the two READMEs in parity). Mention it only polls for the current in-progress season and pauses when the tab is hidden.

Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend`, and `npm run synth` and confirm all pass. Make an incremental git commit on feat/mlb-postseason-site referencing Issue #17 (e.g. 'test(frontend): e2e for auto-refresh affordance + docs/specs (Issue #17)'). Record the commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: A new Playwright spec asserts the localized 'last updated' text and manual refresh button render for an in-progress 2026 bracket.
The spec asserts a results-only season shows NO auto-refresh/refresh affordance (criterion 1 at the UI layer).
Clicking the manual refresh button triggers an additional /bracket fetch and the bracket stays visible (no full loading screen) during refresh.
`.kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md` and `design.md` describe the implemented auto-refresh behavior and reference the real modules.
README.md and README.ja.md both document the feature and remain in parity.
`npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend`, and `npm run synth` all pass.
findings: Completed in commit d68eb72 on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site. NOTE: the repo is at /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason (NOT a nested kiro-mlb-postseason/ subdir). Added frontend/e2e/refresh.spec.ts with two Playwright specs: (1) in-progress 2026 (stubbed via a counting '**/bracket*' route returning SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET) asserts the localized last-updated line (/最終更新/) and the manual refresh button (role button, name /更新/) are visible, that the initial load made exactly 1 /bracket request, then clicks Refresh and asserts the bracket request count reaches >=2 while the bracket region (role region, name /ポストシーズンのトーナメント表/) and the WS card stay visible and the full-screen loading text (/ポストシーズンを読み込み中/) never appears. (2) results-only path: HOW I HANDLED THE RESULTS-ONLY ASSERTION — I read HomePage.tsx and confirmed the refresh bar + last-updated line + manual Refresh button render for ANY started bracket (gated on state.status==='ready' && bracketStarted), so they ARE shown for results-only 2024 too; the 'absent' assertion from the step would be false. Per the orchestrator NOTE and Issue #17 criterion 1 (which is about POLLING), the results-only spec instead stubs '**/bracket*' with a counting route serving a 2024 bracket whose only series is 'final' (no in_progress), drives the season selector to 2024, records the request count after load, waits 3s (well under the 60s interval), and asserts the count is unchanged — i.e. no unprompted auto-poll occurs for a not-predictable / no-in-progress season. Playwright chromium was already installed; no install needed. Updated .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md (new Requirement 14 with 8 EARS criteria: polling predicate, 60s constant vs ~15min TTL, Page Visibility pause/resume, localized relative last-updated, manual refresh button, flicker-free refresh preserving scroll+selected series, unobtrusive failure keeping prior data, stale-season guard) and design.md (new 'Auto-refresh an in-progress bracket (Issue #17)' subsection tracing to relativeTime.ts, useAutoRefresh.ts, HomePage.tsx). Updated README.md and README.ja.md in parity with a 'Live auto-refresh for the in-progress season' section (polls only for the current in-progress season, localized last-updated + manual refresh, pauses when tab hidden, flicker-free). Verification ALL PASS: `npm run build` (shared->backend->frontend->infra), `npm test` (shared 22, backend 92, frontend 57, infra 8), `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` (22 passed, incl. 2 new refresh specs), `npm run synth`.
